text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as the Ramen Jamboree was reaching its climax,
Light Hello approached me with an unexpected consultation.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hae~, that much profit...?! And here we planned
to just break even to repay our debt of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's been a huge hit thanks to everyone.
So I wanted to discuss what to use the funds for...
choice_data_list: I see, that really is a tough dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So here's an idea: how about
holding a "talk event" featuring all of you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: According to a survey conducted by our company, there's quite a demand from people wanting to hear about your dedication to ramen and behind-the-scenes stories...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello showed me the proposal.
It was for an event that past attendees could enjoy even more.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And so, I was wondering if we could ask Nature-san to be the host...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ngh...?! What did you just say? Me, the MC...?!
choice_data_list: Whoa...! That's quite the promotion, huh?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
With Nature-san,
her name recognition, popularity, and ability are all impeccable!
Her approachable personality makes her a perfect fit as well!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you serious...!
Me, in such a huge role...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's a star, she'd certainly be qualified.
However, I didn't want to force her if she wasn't feeling up to it.
Just as I was thinking that...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...I suppose it's about time I made up my mind, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, we got so much support, didn't we?
From everyone here, from Shion-san, and from the fans, too..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You already know, don't you, Trainer?
You asked me so much about it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to hold my head high and live up to it.
No, I have to.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—That's why... I'll do it.
I will give it everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so...
the day of the event arrived in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, it's your MC, Nice Nature!
Hi everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Today, we've got a whole bunch in store for you: secret recipe stories, where the ingredients come from, and even behind-the-scenes tales from the Ramen Jamboree!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature spoke cheerfully and kept things
moving along without a hitch.
However...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do I think?
Nah, pretty much the same as everyone else, really.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, tell me more about Top Road-san
building up her vessel—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to hear what Nature had to say too...
Nah, jumping in out of nowhere would be tough, right? There's scripts and stuff after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see...
Talking about myself, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems reluctant to step into the spotlight.
However, she must have plenty of fans.
In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eh...!
Trai...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Let's do the cheer too!
Ready, set... "We wanna hear it!"
"Nature-san!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—*chuckle*...! Ahahaha...!
Aw, thanks, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well then, maybe I'll give
a little something to answer the cheers—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Phew~~~, gave it my all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The event was a massive hit!
Since the after-party was postponed to a later date,
the two of us stopped by a ramen shop on the way home.
choice_data_list: Good work! It was a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks.
Whew, and here I was wondering how it'd turn out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's thing.
Hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"You gave me a push on the back again.
Seriously, thank you."
choice_data_list: No, no, it was your hard work.
No, no, that's all thanks to your hard work

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her it was because she had always worked so hard.
Her fans love seeing that dedication, which is why
they cheer for her...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I managed to... sparkle this time, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! Thank you!
Alright, extra chashu pork and a large portion for me today!
